entities.summary: Retshegofaditswe 'Tshego' Nché – more commonly referred to as Ox Nché – is a South African rugby union player for the Sharks in the United Rugby Championship and the South African national team. His regular position is loosehead prop. He is an internationally acclaimed scrummager.
